[[File:PowerFromWithin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Force-sensitive]]
{{Quote|You've taken your first step into a larger world.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''Force-sensitive''', also known as a '''Forceful''', '''Force-user''', or '''Force wielder,''' was a being who was highly attuned to the flow of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Force-sensitives could, with training, learn to sense and manipulate the Force. Force-sensitives who gained powers and abilities through the Force became [[Force Adept]]s.

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took Force-sensitive children at a very young age (typically until the age of three, but preferably earlier) to start training them to become Jedi. A notable exception to this was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was accepted for Jedi training when he was just under 10 years old, which would ultimately prove to be the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|downfall]] of the Jedi.

A [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count through special testing could determine how strong one was in the Force.

Trained Jedi (and other Force adepts) could ''sense'' high levels of the Force in individuals. The presence of Force-sensitives in a ''vicinity'' could also be sensed. On rare occasion, such Force-sensitivity could be detected emanating from a powerful "[[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in the Force".<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> If, however, one who was powerfully Force-sensitive―such as [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], or Anakin Skywalker―willed it, even subconsciously, they (or perhaps even the Force itself) could hide or "shroud" them from detection in the Force.<ref name=":0">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref><ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> While [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] had wondered how such a powerful Force "presence" as was centered in a youthful Palpatine might possibly have eluded him, so did Palpatine himself later wonder how he'd sensed absolutely "nothing" of young Anakin Skywalker's presence in the Force when the boy had been a guest in his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[500 Republica/Legends|apartments]].<ref name=":0" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], also, was left to marvel (the year following a mission to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]) how he possibly could have failed to detect the presence of young Skywalker―a being who, "absolutely teeming with midi-chlorians ... may very well be the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]]"―for Skywalker remained for him "''a beacon of power''...": "''How could I have not sensed the presence of one so strong with the Force?''" he continued to wonder―a case of undetected (shrouded) identity that disturbed the venerable [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] so profoundly as to cause Mundi to question his own "perceptive abilities ... Tatooine cannot be a coincidence. I do not believe in coincidences ... but could [Skywalker] really have been conceived by the midi-chlorians, as Qui-Gon suggested? And if he is the Chosen One, destined to bring balance to the Force, why do I sense some danger about this boy?"<ref name="Star Wars 1998 6">[[Star Wars (1998) 6|''Star Wars'' (1998) 6]]</ref><ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

That powerful Force-sensitives ''could go undetected'' was certainly known to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Obi-Wan Kenobi, as a young Jedi Master, once reflected that the Council, in fact, "had long suspected that the Sith knew how to [[Force cloak|disguise]] themselves and pass undetected by Jedi."<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> Though he was not a Sith, this rare ability to go undetected in the Force was also held by the son of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]], [[Granta Omega]], who moreover possessed the rare power to appear to some Force-sensitives as a [[Force void/Legends|Void in the Force]], a "Force blank."<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref>

To achieve higher levels of accuracy in Force-sensitive detection for Jedi candidacy, trained Jedi performed special tests to measure midi-chlorian counts in cells (such as Obi-Wan Kenobi, at the behest of Qui-Gon Jinn, did for Anakin Skywalker).

There were also other testing technologies developed to hunt Force-sensitives during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Species and objects==
[[File:AuraoftheForce-AoD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Force-sensitive Twi'lek perceives the aura of the Force]]
Species with a high number of Force-sensitives included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dors]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], and even the rare and mysterious [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuins]]. Species producing low numbers of Force-sensitives included the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]]. The [[Neti/Legends|Neti]], [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]], [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] (a Human tribe), [[Vahla]], [[Sith (species)/Legends|Red Sith]], [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]], [[:Category:Force-sensitive species|and many other species]] were entirely composed of Force-sensitives. [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] may all have possessed the ability to sense [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], although they had little practical use for it. [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]], as a species, were all in tune with the Force, but none were known to have become Jedi.

A creature or object did not necessarily need to be [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] to be able to possess Force sensitivity. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] once gave [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] a [[River stone|stone]] from his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld|homeworld's]] "River of Light" which by unknown means appeared to be Force-sensitive in Kenobi's opinion.

Creatures such as the [[vornskr]] and [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] were other examples of non-sentient creatures who were considered Force-sensitive. An ancient [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] species was even rumored to have established a Force-sensitive run civilization relying on [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy. The [[Qom Jha and Qom Qae]] were slightly Force-sensitive and could communicate through telepathy with any being who was Force-sensitive.

Certain species, such as [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]] and the Humans of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], openly feared or detested those who could be touched by the Force. This was especially true of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who not only could not feel the Force, but were mostly unaffected by it, save for indirect applications or bursts of energy.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] had lost their sensitivity since the days of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], but held experiments to rekindle it in subsequent generations. One offshoot of the Rakata, the primitive, mutated [[Flesh Raider]]s, had [[Fashk|one]] known member during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that was Force-sensitive.

==Origins==
People achieved Force-sensitivity by three known means. They either inherited it from a Force-sensitive progenitor (which was most often the case), acquired the sensitivity through random mutation or evolution, or, in rare cases, one was artificially imbued with sensitivity to the Force, such as was the case of the [[Reborn]] and [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]].

[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], a master of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|manipulation]], lived during the century leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Obsessed with eternal life, Plagueis experimented with ways to cheat death and create new life from the Force-sensitive-determining midi-chlorians.

Plagueis' [[Grand Experiment|experiments]] in creating life may have, in a sense, succeeded. For, according to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], it was Plagueis―having conceived and initiated his plans well before succumbing to death―who influenced the midi-chlorians to ''conceive'' Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Vader">''[[Vader: The Ultimate Guide]]''</ref> In reality, however, Plagueis' influence in that miraculous conception had only been an indirect one, as it proved to be the Force ''itself'' "striking back" for the Sith Lord's blasphemous meddling in the processes of life and creation that caused the fatherless conception of the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]].<ref name=":0" />

Latent Force-sensitivity could also be artificially activated or magnified; some members of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Side Elite]] benefited from this process.

==Abilities of Force-sensitives==
{{Quote|With that kind of luck they don't need any skill|[[Zu Pike]] about Luke Skywalker and company.|<ref name="SotEE5">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 5|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 5]]</ref>}}
The Force, being far more powerful than any machine in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], had the ability to be used as a weapon by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], or as a tool by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In either case, the Force gave Force-sensitives the ability to perform actions that would have otherwise been considered impossible. For instance, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had the ability, even at over 800 years old, to use the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] form of [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]], demanding incredible acrobatics and speed. This was in no small part due to his amazing power in the Force. Some [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] included healing, psychokinesis, increased physical abilities, foresight, and various offensive techniques, such as the notorious [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

[[File:Dandy_Gambler_FDCR.png|thumb|right|180px|A Devaronian male uses the Force to gamble]]
Force-sensitives were considered to have an unusual amount of luck, lucky guesses, and correct decisions; this was how droids could recognize Force-sensitives and enlist them for the [[New Jedi Order]]. Most untrained Force-sensitives still had raw Force associated talents, such as improved reaction time, physical strength, an affinity to animals, weather or certain other aspects of the Force. 

For example, due to his raw Force abilities, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was an accomplished pilot at the age of ten, despite a complete lack of formal training, and was able to successfully compete in [[Podracing/Legends|pod races]], despite it generally being considered impossible for a human to do so, due to the extreme reflexes required. Another example was a young [[Galen Marek]] pulled [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|Vader's weapon]] out of his hand with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], without any Force training. As a child, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was also able to use a powerful [[Force push|Force Push]] to force a [[Weequay]] raider away from herself with no training.

It was commonly considered near impossible to wield a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] without a sense of the Force. This was, however, an exaggeration; though the unique properties of a lightsaber made it more difficult to effectively wield than a standard melee weapon, non-sensitives successfully utilized them on numerous occasions. However, Force-users were generally more accomplished combatants, able to use the Force to perform feats with their weapon that a non-sensitive individual would not be able to match. 

It did, however, require Force sensitivity and, except in rare cases such as [[Jaden Korr]], some degree of training to successfully build one.

Some Force-sensitives such as [[Streen]] were known to have drastic side effects for possessing Force sensitivity, although not having the knowledge to properly control it.

==Force-sensitives throughout history==
{{Quote|The Force is strong with you.|Darth Sidious to Darth Vader, his new apprentice|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:Blood_test_EGTF.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A blood test for a Force-sensitive]]
In the Old Republic era, Force-sensitives were typically discovered by the Jedi at a young age and enlisted for training as Jedi. Individuals discovered late enough to have developed family ties and friendships with others were not generally trained; an example of this was [[Alexi Garyn]]. This rule originated after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Exar Kun War]] but was not strictly enforced until after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

[[Meetra Surik]] had a gift of attracting Force-sensitives towards her, such as [[Atton Rand]], [[Mical]], [[Brianna]], and [[Mira]].

During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, the latter's leader, [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]], attempted to use a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]], created by [[Darth Nul]], to amplify the abilities of Force-sensitives deemed too weak in the Force to be trained by the Jedi or Sith. She hoped to draft these individuals into her army to use as Force-sensitive [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s.<ref name="Defiance">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref> The process was ultimately successful, but many of the Force-sensitives had been captured during [[Hidden Chain raids]], and were reluctant to fight for the Field Marshal. The plan ultimately failed when the [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|holocron was retrieved and the Force-sensitives liberated]].<ref name="sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref> 

Throughout the modern history of the [[Great Peace of the Republic|Republic]], the Jedi Order made a concerted effort to identify Force-sensitive individuals from birth. Children who exhibited the necessary traits—typically determined by high midi-chlorian counts—were tested early in life. Those who met the Order’s criteria were taken under its care for guided development and training.<ref name=":1">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Both the Jedi and the Republic believed that only structured instruction could prevent untrained Force-users from succumbing to the dark side. Leaving such individuals to develop their powers on their own posed a grave risk—not just to themselves, but to others—potentially unleashing dangerous individuals with little understanding of their abilities or responsibility.<ref name=":1" />

Despite these safeguards, the system was far from perfect. The vastness of the galaxy meant that some Force-sensitive children inevitably went unnoticed. In rare but painful cases, families even refused to relinquish their children to the Jedi. These situations placed the Order in a difficult position—torn between honoring the wishes of parents and ensuring the safety and well-being of both the child and the galaxy as a whole.<ref name=":1" />

Beyond relaying to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] the prodigious test results of a theretofore unsurpassed midi-chlorian count, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] discovered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] through the boy's prowess at [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]]. Anakin himself once believed as a boy that he had a "string of lucky guesses," when actually these guesses were early indicators of the Force. His mother [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] noticed these anomalies in her son as well, and described Anakin Skywalker as "special." Indeed he was, for Skywalker had no biological father.

Other potential Jedi had been discovered in roughly the same way - when there seemed to be an unusual amount of luck associated with an individual. When Luke Skywalker was looking for candidates for his [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]] he told the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to search for people with an unnatural amount of luck. Although [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was not known to be Force-sensitive (and, in fact, was skeptical of its existence before meeting [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]), he was known for his self described "Smuggler's Luck". This lead his daughter, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], to speculate that he may potentially have a mild form of Force-sensitivity.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> 

[[File:The_Force_Revealed_FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] child reveals her Force-sensitivity protecting her family from a stormtrooper]]
During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Force-sensitives were known to be taken in to be trained as [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], or otherwise. Most Force-sensitives discovered by the Empire however, were killed due to three possible factors: the threat of other powerful Force wielders was a fear of Palpatine's and as such most were simply eliminated on sight, discovered [[Alien/Legends|alien]] Force-sensitives were likely killed upon discovery as [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] would suggest, or some were eliminated due to lack of sufficient power during vigorous "tests" performed by Imperials.

Although untrained, Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]] was Force attuned.<ref name="Dyer">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Colonel Dyer}}</ref>

In some cases, such as those of [[Fionah Ti]], [[Vaner Shan]] and [[Theron Shan]], children of Jedi and other Force-sensitives were incapable of using the Force, a rare and unexplained phenomenon that occurred in random generations.

==Force-user==
[[File:ForceSensitiveEmergent-AoRCR.png|thumb|left|180px|An emergent Force-sensitive in the Rebel Alliance ignites a lightsaber]]
The terms '''Force-user''' and '''Force-sensitive''' were distinct in meaning. Force-sensitive denoted anyone with Force power, latent or active, while being called a Force-user implied that the individual had at least some understanding and control of their abilities and was able to use them to accomplish specific tasks. The latter was also used in a more specific sense as a general term for Force-trained individuals who did not belong to either of the two major Force traditions, the Jedi and the Sith. Another term for Force-user was '''[[Force Adept]]''', for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-siders]] sometimes '[[Dark side adept/Legends|''Dark Side Adept''']] (not to be confused with the Imperial title and organization proper).

==Detecting the Force==
The main form of detecting the Force through midi-chlorian count was lost to the Jedi because of the Empire's destruction of documents and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The head of the New Jedi Order, Luke Skywalker, discovered a different way to reveal Force-sensitivity. In Leia's quarters in the abandoned Emperor Palpatine's Imperial Palace on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Luke and his twin sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] were doing some tests on the inner defenses of her brain. Luke was using the Force to access certain areas of the brain; as he accessed an area in the very back of the brain, he was rebuffed. They confirmed this to be a natural reflex of the Force-sensitive.

During the rebuilding of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after it was claimed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the team he was leading discovered a chamber of Jedi-related artifacts possibly concealed by [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]]. Items found there included a type of [[Force detector|scanning device]] that could detect an aura of the Force around a person. R2-D2 was equipped with this scanner to aid [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in searching for Force-sensitives to join Luke's new Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.

At some point in the future, the New Jedi Order would rediscover midi-chlorians and begin using blood tests to better find Force-sensitives.

Sometimes Jedi went into a trance and found a Force-sensitive by detecting the child through the Force itself. This technique was hard to master and spread the Jedi's Force abilities thin as the Jedi cannot fight or concentrate on anything else combined with concentrating on a large number of beings. The technique also requires time to use effectively, which may not be a good idea when things must be done as quickly as possible.

==Independent Force-users==
Besides Sith and Jedi traditions and Imperial dark side cadres, there were other organizations devoted to the Force. These often originated in another earlier tradition, but had left it after a schism or similar event. These could belong to either the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] or dark side, or simply exist somewhere in between. Some of the better known examples of independent Force-user groups included the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]], the [[Witches of Dathomir]], the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] Monks, the [[Baran Do]], the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]], the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]] as well as many other Force-based organizations. Also, some Force-users did not adhere to any code or creed, but were self-taught or raised and trained by independent masters. There was also a family of Force-wielders known as "[[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]]" on the planet [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]].
